finish_summary:
bulk_discount_percent(50) returns 5 but specification says 10.
parse_coupon does not accept lowercase or whitespace‑trimmed codes, though spec requires case‑insensitive matching and surrounding whitespace ignored.
Cart.remove_item leaves an item with quantity 0 instead of removing it; spec says remove entirely when quantity reaches 0.
Cart.subtotal applies no bulk discount for quantity 5 – spec requires 5% discount at qty>=10.
